Muramasa also seemed somewhat listless.

We were not convalescing at a holiday resort. In the middle of enemy territory would be closer to the facts. Seen that way, this much worry might count as relatively light—but whichever interpretation I selected, my eyelids descended.

Apparently I was not constructed with the skill to overcome fatigue by theoretical argument.

　そう思えば、この程度の気苦労はまだしも軽いもの
なのかもしれないが――どう思おうと目蓋は下がる。

　理論武装で疲労を克服できるほど俺は器用に出来て
いないようだ。

en.html:
Nothing that should provoke suspicion.

The furnishings stood as they had that morning. Signs of cleaning, but naturally that meant only cleaning. Somebody must have attended to it while I was absent.

Nothing suspicious.

The room, unchanged from memory.
Only the sounds made by Muramasa and me.
A faint fragrance of plants and flowers.

en.html:
For some reason, I felt isolated. Anger of the same quality and quantity seemed to approach from front and rear.

For now, I concentrated on the front. One glance established that he was not heavily armed. No firearm or great sword could be hidden under that black clothing. His outline made it plain.

Not that his danger decreased in the slightest. Indoors, a small concealed weapon was more useful—and therefore a threat to me.

With sufficient skill and intent to kill, he could <ruby>cut<rt>slit</rt></ruby> my throat in a flash whose path I never saw. At present, there was no basis for judging him deficient in either.

By every appearance, a fighting man.
And if such a man was an intruder in <ruby>the Kubou's headquarters<rt>here</rt></ruby>—

　正面と背後から同質同量の怒りが迫っているように
感じられてならない。

　とりあえず、正面に意識を集中する。
　一見して断定できるのは、重武装ではないという事
だ。銃砲も大剣も黒衣の下には潜ませてあるまい。体
の線から自明である。

　といって、危険性が些かでも揺らぐ事はないが。
　室内である点に思慮を致せば、隠し持てる程の小型
兵装の方が有用であり、つまり俺にとっては脅威。

　男に充分な業と殺意があれば、軌跡も見せぬ一閃で

根拠は、今のところ皆無である。

黒瀬"At this point, I ask no miraculous escape with my life. As you wish, I shall make one flower bloom in death."

黒瀬"...What?"

Kageaki"A deep wound, I judge. Your color suggests considerable blood loss... If bleeding begins again, your life will certainly be in danger."
Kageaki"An uproar drawing people here would be inconvenient also. Kindly consider your movements with care."
黒瀬"............"
黒瀬"Who are you?"
Kageaki"............"

en.html:
黒瀬"You will not answer...?"
Kageaki"No. My apologies. Finding the answer caused a small delay."
Kageaki"Kageaki Minato. For certain reasons I am staying with the Kubou of Horigoe... Something like a guest living at her expense."
黒瀬"...A guest?"
Kageaki"There is no other adequate description of my position."
Muramasa"...There really is not..."
黒瀬"You serve neither Rokuhara nor the Kubou of Horigoe?"
Kageaki"I owe her food and lodging. But we are not lord and retainer."
黒瀬"..."
黒瀬"What do you intend to do with me?"
Kageaki"You are the person pursued after causing some disturbance here this morning."
黒瀬"..."
Kageaki"Made it seem you escaped outside, hid within instead, and waited for late night...?"
黒瀬"..."
Kageaki"I see. Even outside the mansion, this is Horigoe's military district. More reliable than fleeing blindly."

en.html:
I had never expected an honest answer.

Almost certainly an anti-shogunate activist.
...What should I do?

Hostility served no purpose. I had stated that myself. Yet I had no reason to join his cause.

Neutrality was not among the choices prepared for this situation. Keep him in my room, and I helped. Drive him out, and I opposed him. In practice, at least.

Given the obligation of food and shelter, helping someone who had entered with plainly unfriendly intentions was uncomfortable. But without my help his position would certainly become hopeless. Death would certainly follow.

He bore hostility toward the shogunate and had probably fought Horigoe's soldiers. But there was no sign that he had turned his blade on noncombatants.

I could not bring myself to kick him out to his death. Yet if sheltering him gave him an opportunity, and he chose sabotage against the headquarters rather than escape—

I could not call the resulting damage none of my responsibility.

ja.html:
正直な答が返ってくるとは、最初から思っていない。

　十中八九、倒幕派の志士であろう。
　……どうするべきか。

　敵対するのは全く無益である。既に自分の口で言明
した通り。
　といって、加勢する筋ではない。

　中立の選択は――この状況に用意されていなかった。
　部屋に留めるなら味方、追い出すなら敵対であろう。
事実上の。

　寝食の義理を思えば、明白な非友好的意図を持って
侵入した者に幾らかでも手を貸すのは気が引ける。
　しかし現状況、俺が手を貸さねば彼の進退が窮まる
のは確実であり、その結果彼が死ぬのも確実である。

　彼は幕府に敵意を持ち、この堀越の将兵とも干戈を
交えたのだろうが、非戦闘員にまで刃を振るったわけ
ではない。
　そんな形跡は全く無かった。

　彼を死地へ蹴り出す気にはとてもなれない。
　だが、彼を匿った結果――機会を得た彼が逃亡する
代わり公方府に対する破壊行動へ踏み切るような事が、
万一にでもあったなら。

　そこで生じる被害に、俺の責任なしとは言えまい。
